attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Notice of Extraordinary General Meeting to be held on December 11, 2026
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has issued a notice for Extraordinary General Meeting Number 01/2026-27 to be held on December 11, 2026, at 11:00 a.m. via video conferencing. The meeting will consider a special resolution to issue up to 22,10,885 convertible warrants to Bennett, Coleman and Company Limited on a preferential basis. Each warrant carries an entitlement to subscribe to one equity share of face value Rs. 10 at a price of Rs. 73.50. The total aggregation value is up to Rs. 16,25,00,047.50. The relevant date for determining the minimum price is November 11, 2026. Warrants must be exercised within 18 months of allotment. At least 25% of the issue price is payable at allotment, with the balance 75% payable upon conversion. E-voting commences on December 8, 2026, at 09:00 a.m. and ends on December 10, 2026, at 05:00 p.m. The resolution is pending shareholder approval.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Revision in Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026'.
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited filed a revision to its Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company inadvertently reported figures as on March 31, 2026, instead of September 30, 2025, in the Cash Flow statement of both Standalone and Consolidated results. The revised Cash Flow statements have been attached. The company affirms there are no other changes to the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the period. The Board of Directors approved these results on November 13, 2026. The Statutory Auditors issued an unmodified report on the limited review.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited published its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The standalone results show a loss after tax of 11.52 crores for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, compared to a loss of 7.42 crores in the corresponding period last year. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, the standalone loss after tax was 3.66 crores, versus a profit of 25.85 crores in the prior year. Consolidated results for the same quarter reported a profit after tax of 609.66 crores, up from 565.97 crores in the previous year. The consolidated half-year profit after tax was 1,192.33 crores, compared to 1,063.63 crores previously. The results were approved by the Board on November 13, 2026. The Bombay Burmah Trading Corporation Limited announced a special window for transfer and dematerialization of physical shares from February 5, 2026, to February 4, 2027. Rana Sugars Limited reported a loss after tax of 438.85 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. Man Industries India Limited reported a net profit after tax of 4,002 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 13, 2026, titled "Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.".
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited filed a press release regarding its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations grew 15% year-on-year to Rs. 218 Crs in H1 FY27. EBITDA increased 14% to Rs. 72.3 Crs with a margin of 33%. Footfalls rose 16.5% to 13.65 Lakhs. The Board approved the divestment of its 287-key Novotel Imagicaa hotel to Juniper Hotels Limited for INR 248 crore. The Board also approved issuing warrants for equity shares worth Rs 16.25 Crs to Bennett Coleman & Co Ltd. The company invested Rs. 50 Crs to acquire a 50.002% stake in Mehsana Next Parks Pvt. Ltd., which operates Shanku’s Water Park. Hello Park Hyderabad is expected to commence operations in the coming months.

attchmntText: Please find enclosed Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited filed the Monitoring Agency Report for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, issued by India Ratings & Research Private Limited. The report concerns the utilization of proceeds from a Preferential Issue of 2,34,82,500 Equity Shares and Convertible Warrants at INR 73.50 per security, totaling INR 345.19 Crores. No deviation from the objects was observed. Utilization stands at INR 215.74 Crores, with INR 129.45 Crores unutilized. The unutilized amount is invested in Fixed Deposits with HDFC Bank. Repayment of loans to Malpani Parks Indore Private Limited and intercorporate loans have been completed. Part payment for operational parks acquired from Giriraj Enterprises and General Corporate Purpose utilization are ongoing.

attchmntText: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited has informed the Exchange about Preferential issue of Convertible Warrants
voiceSummary: Imagicaaworld Entertainment Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company reported a loss after tax of 3,910.16 lakhs for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, and a profit after tax of 1,400.38 lakhs for the half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved a preferential issue of up to 22,10,885 convertible warrants to non-promoters at Rs. 73.50 each, raising up to Rs. 16,25,00,047.50. This issue is subject to shareholder and regulatory approval. An Extraordinary General Meeting will be held on December 11, 2026, via video conferencing to seek shareholder approval for the preferential issue.
